blocks.text: The module documentation describes preview embedding, inspector injection, live reload tunneling, explicit HTTP framing, and the loopback-only threat model. It rejects absolute-form proxy requests, hostile Host headers, ambiguous framing, and non-loopback targets.
blocks.title: Proxy scope and security posture

blocks.text: PreviewProxyConfig formats the upstream origin and Host header. URL, loopback, port, self-target, and collision checks in build_preview_config ensure the proxy fronts only a local dev server distinct from MiniMe.
blocks.title: Configuration validation

blocks.anchor: def _header(headers: Headers, name: str) -> str | None:
blocks.text: Pure helpers find headers and connection tokens, build and inject the inspector tag, rewrite CSP and origins, remove hop-by-hop response headers, and decide whether a response is an HTML document eligible for injection.
blocks.title: Header and HTML rewriting

blocks.text: Strict parsers reject malformed lines, obsolete folding, non-origin request targets, invalid statuses, and ambiguous Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding combinations. Body helpers copy framed bytes or read bounded de-chunked HTML.
blocks.title: HTTP parsing and body framing

blocks.anchor: async def _pipe(reader: asyncio.StreamReader, writer: asyncio.StreamWriter) -> None:
blocks.text: _pipe copies bytes until a side closes, and _tunnel runs two pipes concurrently until either direction completes. This keeps WebSocket traffic opaque after the handshake.
blocks.title: Streaming and upgrade plumbing

blocks.text: PreviewProxy binds the loopback listener, tracks writers for shutdown, validates Host and framing, connects to the fixed upstream, skips interim responses, rewrites or injects normal responses, and hands 101 upgrades to the tunnel.
blocks.title: Serving preview requests

blocks.anchor: def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
blocks.text: main parses target, frontend-origin, and port arguments, builds the validated configuration, starts the proxy, waits until interruption, and returns a configuration error code when settings are invalid.
blocks.title: Standalone entry point

how_it_works: Validates one loopback upstream and frontend origin
Parses strict HTTP heads and body framing
Buffers eligible HTML to inject the inspector script
Tunnels WebSocket upgrades and streams ordinary bodies
purpose: The proxy fronts one configured local dev server for the workbench preview. It validates loopback configuration, protects the listener from open-proxy and framing attacks, rewrites browser-facing headers, injects the inspector into bounded HTML documents, and copies other traffic or WebSocket bytes without interpretation.
side_effects: opens local listening and upstream sockets
summary: Runs a loopback-only HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy that rewrites preview responses and tunnels WebSocket upgrades.
